draft.text: You came in because you have had right shoulder pain for about three weeks.
You said it started after you fell while painting on a ladder and braced yourself with your arm.
You describe the pain as a dull ache that is constant but sometimes comes and goes.
You have limited movement and tenderness in your shoulder.
There is no swelling, redness, or numbness.
The pain is likely related to the fall you had.
There are no other medical conditions or previous injuries mentioned.
An X-ray has already been done and showed no broken bones.
An MRI has been ordered to get more information.
Your doctor will keep checking on your condition and may change the treatment plan if needed.
